# Topmarks

> > Free interactive educational games, maths worksheets, and teaching resources for primary school children aged 3-11.

Topmarks is a comprehensive educational platform offering age-grouped learning activities across mathematics, English literacy, and phonics. Popular resources include Hit the Button for times tables practice, Letters and Sounds phonics programs, and interactive games like Paint the Squares and Helicopter Rescue designed for Key Stage 1 and Key Stage 2 learners.

## Key Topics

- Primary Education (ages 3-11)
- Interactive Learning Games
- Maths Games & Mental Arithmetic
- Letters and Sounds Phonics
- Hit the Button
- Teaching Resources & Worksheets
- Key Stage 1 & 2 (KS1/KS2)
- Phonics Games (Phase 2, Phase 3)
- Fractions and Decimals
- Age-Grouped Learning (5-7 years, 7-11 years)
- CVC Words & Phoneme Recognition
- Times Tables Practice
- Early Reading & Literacy
- Educational Resources for Teachers

## Main Platform

- [Topmarks – Free Interactive Learning Games, Maths Worksheets & Teaching Resources](https://www.topmarks.co.uk/): Homepage for Topmarks educational platform with games and resources

## Mathematics Games & Resources

- [Learn to Count with fun Counting Games for KS1 Children](https://www.topmarks.co.uk/maths-games): KS1 counting games for ages 5-7 covering numbers 1-100
- [Hit the Button - Quick fire maths practise for 6-11 year olds](https://www.topmarks.co.uk/maths-games/hit-the-button): Popular times tables and mental maths game for ages 6-11
- [Fractions and Decimals Maths Games](https://www.topmarks.co.uk/maths-games/7-11-years/fractions-and-decimals): Fractions and decimals games for ages 7-11 including equivalence

## English & Phonics Games

- [Letters and Sounds, English Games for 5-7 Years - Topmarks](https://www.topmarks.co.uk/english-games): English literacy games for ages 5-7 with phonics and Letters & Sounds
